items.summary: Fix PostCard component so that image and video media attached to posts is correctly rendered and visible. Ensure the media URL/blob is properly resolved and passed to the img/video element so content displays for all posts across all pages.

Fix ProfilePage so that the current user's posts grid correctly fetches and displays all posts including those with images and videos. Ensure the posts query is called with the correct principal and that the resulting media blobs are rendered.
Fix UserProfilePage so that any public user's posts grid fetches and displays all posts including those with images and videos, resolved by either principal ID or handle.
Fix ShortSportPage (short video feed) so that video posts are fetched and rendered with working playback. Ensure video src is correctly set from the backend blob/URL data.
Fix ExplorePage so that posts returned by useGetAllPosts render their media (images and videos) correctly, applying the same blob resolution fix used in PostCard.

Audit and fix the ExternalBlob rendering utility (used in AvatarPlaceholder and PostCard) to ensure binary blob data returned from the backend is correctly converted to an object URL or data URL before being assigned to img/video src attributes.
